selected.rationale: Loss on compose-post->unique-id blocks the mandatory post-ID generation; a synchronous no-timeout Thrift call hangs or fails, exposing missing timeout/retry defense on the core write path.
Loss on compose-post->post-storage prevents persisting the post, so the compose-post request cannot complete; this reveals missing timeout/retry handling on the storage dependency.
Loss on home-timeline->post-storage breaks the timeline read path and is amplified because post-storage is queried per followee, exposing missing timeout/fallback on a high-fanout edge.
The text service is a required compose-post dependency; loss on this edge stalls post creation and shows whether the fan-out has robust timeout and error handling.
User resolution is mandatory before composing a post; loss on compose-post->user can hang the entire write request if no bounded timeout is present.
compose-post->home-timeline propagates the post to followers; loss on this edge leaves timeline writes incomplete and can fail the overall post transaction.
compose-post->user-timeline updates the author's own timeline; loss on this edge exposes synchronous write-path coupling without retry or fallback.
Loss on home-timeline->social-graph removes follower data required for timeline reads; without a timeout every home-timeline read will hang or fail.
Media is a compose-post dependency for posts with media; loss on this edge blocks those posts, but the lower call frequency for media-less requests reduces its expected impact.

Killing unique-id removes a single-source dependency; without retry/fallback or automatic recovery, compose-post remains unavailable until the pod restarts, exposing availability and recovery weaknesses.
